title: The Saboteur
summary: Adds HDR support by upgrading the scene render targets and replacing the final hard-clip composite with a tone mapper.
notes: Load ReShade as d3d9.dll with DXVK (dxgi_dxvk.dll) so the D3D11/D3D12 swapchain proxy can present HDR.
Use borderless/windowed mode for HDR output.
